intro: IIM Nagpur and IMT Nagpur both sit in Nagpur, and this page compares their recorded MBA / PGDM fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

IIM Nagpur vs IMT Nagpur is not a single winner. IIM Nagpur is recorded as a public institute, while IMT Nagpur is private. IIM Nagpur holds NIRF 2025 rank 25 and IMT Nagpur holds rank 99 in the same listing we have.

sections.heading: IIM Nagpur vs IMT Nagpur for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIM Nagpur if you want a public MBA / PGDM option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus, including the stronger NIRF 2025 rank on this page.
Choose IMT Nagpur if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.

IIM Nagpur lists Certificate Programme Cyber Security, Certificate Programme Financial Technology, Certificate Programme General Management and more. IMT Nagpur lists PGDM (Marketing), Post Graduate Diploma in International Business Business Analytics, Post Graduate Diploma in International Business Economics and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
IIM Nagpur's official MBA page lists a two-year programme total of ₹21 lakh for the 2026–28 batch, plus a ₹1 lakh offer-acceptance payment that is adjusted against Term I.

IMT Nagpur's official fee page lists a two-year residential total of ₹16 lakh for the PGDM, PGDM (Marketing) and PGDM (Financial Management) batch of 2027–29. That figure includes academic fees, hostel and food, alumni membership and refundable caution money.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: The institute's audited final placement report for the 2023–25 MBA batch records a highest maximum earning potential of ₹69.57 lakh, an average of ₹18.00 lakh and a median of ₹17.04 lakh. These are historical figures, not a promise for the next class.
Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for IMT Nagpur on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: IIM Nagpur's flagship MBA is a CAT route, as published on its admissions policy pages.
IMT Nagpur's recorded admission tests on this page include CAT, XAT.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Nagpur, Maharashtra. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a CAT-centred two-year MBA, a NIRF 2025 Management rank in the mid-20s and the stronger audited 2025 placement year on this page, IIM Nagpur is the clearer fit.
If you want a private PGDM in Nagpur with a published two-year residential fee of ₹16 lakh that already includes hostel and food, IMT Nagpur is the more direct alternative.

faqs.answer: It depends on the MBA / PGDM programme you want. IIM Nagpur has the stronger NIRF rank on this page. Match the course, city and official fee before you decide.

faqs.question: Which exams do IIM Nagpur and IMT Nagpur accept for MBA / PGDM?
faqs.answer: IIM Nagpur is recorded with CAT. IMT Nagpur is recorded with CAT, XAT. Confirm the current official admission brochure, because listed tests can change by year.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for IIM Nagpur and IMT Nagpur?
faqs.answer: The institute's audited final placement report for the 2023–25 MBA batch records a highest maximum earning potential of ₹69.57 lakh, an average of ₹18.00 lakh and a median of ₹17.04 lakh. These are historical figures, not a promise for the next class. Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for IMT Nagpur on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.

faqs.question: Are IIM Nagpur and IMT Nagpur in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
